HuntMark

Public land hunting, by species. Browse WMAs, State Parks, National Forests, and Army Corps land — filter by the species you're after, and save your favorite spots.

In development · no release date yet

Try the live map →

See the roadmap →

Features

Find your spot, by species

HuntMark starts from the question hunters actually ask — "where can I hunt deer, turkey, or waterfowl?" — instead of making you dig through a map built for someone else's state.

🦌

Species-First Search

Pick a species and see every public location where it's in season — instead of browsing a map one pin at a time.

🗺️

Real Parcel Boundaries

Satellite/hybrid map with actual property polygons, not just a pin dropped somewhere near the property.

📍

Verified Access Points

GIS-sourced parking and access points, plus acreage, county, regulations, and weapon restrictions for each property.

⭐

Save Your Favorite Spots

Bookmark the locations you return to, right on the device — no account required to keep a list.

🔒

No Accounts, No Tracking

100% offline-friendly data model. Nothing you save is uploaded anywhere — it stays on your device, full stop.

🇺🇸

Veteran Owned

Built by a veteran-owned studio, for the hunters who use public land every season.

In active development

HuntMark is being built right now, starting with Texas public land. The ship gate is simple: Army Corps and WMA data has to be accurate and boundary-mapped before it goes out the door. No beta and no release date yet.

🚧 iOS app in progress 🗺️ Starting with Texas public land 🔒 On-device by design
